title: Mrs. Gwendolyn Maud Andrews

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE G.S. 1237 22 11 41）
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
S. 1. Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date November 21, 1941.

SUBJECT: Miss Gwendolyn Maud Andrews

Miss Gwendolyn Maud Andrews was born in
Shanghai on October 4th 1920. Her father H. J.
Andrews, British subject by birth, was with the
Shanghai Power Company until his retirement some
four years ago. Her mother is believed to be
Eurasian but is a British subject born in Hongkong
on October 12th 1878. The mother's maiden name
was Minnie Phillips, daughter of T. Phillips, who
was born in Portsmouth and a woman whose particulars
are not known in Shanghai.

（批：a/op）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH NOV 21 1941）

Miss Andrews, who is employed as a stenographer
with the Phoenix Assurance Company, No. 18 The Bund,
has a brother in the Yee Tsoong (B.A.T.) Tobacco
Company, another in H.M. Forces and a sister who
is married to an N.C.O. in the Seaforth Highlanders.
Her religion is Church of England and she is
a regular attendant at the Cathedral where she sings
in the choir.

The family is very respectable and nothing
is known to the detriment of Miss Andrews.

（批：Q. 21/11
L. 21/11）

R.W. Mac Lile.
D. S. I.

A. C. (Special Branch).

（印：INDEXED BY (S.I.) REGISTRY DATE 21/11/41）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 总务处 1237 41年11月22日）
机密报告
S. 1. 特别巡捕房站。档案号.................... 日期 1941年11月21日。

事由：格温多琳·莫德·安德鲁斯小姐

格温多琳·莫德·安德鲁斯小姐于
1920年10月4日出生于
上海。其父 H. J.
安德鲁斯，生为英国臣民，曾在
上海电力公司任职，直至约四年前退休。其母据信为
欧亚混血儿，但系英国臣民，1878年10月12日出生于香港。母亲婚前姓名为明妮·菲利普斯（Minnie Phillips），系 T. 菲利普斯之女，T. 菲利普斯出生于朴次茅斯，另有一女，其在沪详情不详。

（批：a/op）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别处 1941年11月21日）

安德鲁斯小姐受雇于外滩18号凤凰保险公司，担任速记员，
她有一名兄弟在颐中烟草公司（英美烟草公司），另一名兄弟在英国军队服役，还有一位姐妹嫁给了海福尔高地团的一名士官。她的宗教信仰为英国国教，并定期在大教堂做礼拜，且在唱诗班歌唱。

该家庭声誉良好，未发现任何有损安德鲁斯小姐名声之事。

（批：Q. 11/21
L. 11/21）

R.W. Mac Lile.
副督察长。

助理总监（特别处）。

（印：由（情报科）登记室索引 日期 41年11月21日）

REF. NO. E. P. NO. A. 140
POLICE DEPARTMENT.
HONG KONG.
8th November, 1941.

Sir,

I have the honour to ask if you would be good enough to let
me have a note on the under-mentioned lady, particularly on the
subject of her race, parentage and nationality:-

Miss Gwendolyn Maud Andrews - A British subject. Born
4.10.20. (probably in Shanghai). Residing at No.414
Embarkment Building, North Soochow Road, Shanghai.
She is employed as a stenographer with the Phoenix
Assurance Co. No. 18 The Bund, Shanghai. Parents are
British subjects. Father, English - retired - formerly
with the Shanghai Power Co. Mother, a British subject -
father English - mother Chinese; both residing at 414
Embankment Building, North Soochow Road.

Lance Sergeant A. 140 Brown of this Police Force has applied
for permission to marry this lady. Marriages between European
officers of this Force and women of Asiatic race are disapproved.

I accordingly write to you asking for information about this
lady so that I may be properly guided before coming to a decision.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
p./Commissioner of Police.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai,
CHINA.

参考号 E. P. 号 A. 140
警务处。
香港。
1941年11月8日。

先生，

谨请惠予提供关于下述女士的说明，特别是关于其种族、出身及国籍方面：-

格温多琳·莫德·安德鲁斯小姐 - 英国臣民。生于
1920年10月4日。（可能在上海）。居住于上海北苏州路堤岸大厦414号。
她受雇于上海外滩18号凤凰保险公司，担任速记员。父母均为
英国臣民。父亲，英国人 - 已退休 - 前上海电力公司职员。母亲，英国臣民 -
父亲英国人 - 母亲中国人；均居住于北苏州路堤岸大厦414号。

本警队之代理下士 A. 140 布朗已申请获准与该女士结婚。本警队欧洲籍警官与亚裔女性之间的婚姻不予批准。

因此致函阁下，询问有关该女士的信息，以便我在做出决定之前得到适当的指导。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
代警务处处长。

致：
中国，
上海，
警务处处长。
